llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: The new method CompactWithDeletionMarkers must be added to the Syncer struct in Thanos to remove specific blocks from the in-memory state and mark them for deletion in object storage. A parallel implementation is required for Mimir's metaSyncer to support multi-tenant deletion-mark-aware compaction. Both BucketCompactor structs in Thanos and Mimir need wrapper methods to expose this functionality to the high-level compaction loops.

FILES:
- thanos/pkg/compact/compact.go — Add CompactWithDeletionMarkers method to Thanos Syncer struct and wrapper to BucketCompactor.
- thanos/pkg/block/metadata/markers.go — Reference DeletionMark struct definition for the method signature.
- thanos/pkg/compact/compact_test.go — Add unit tests for the new Syncer method.
- mimir/pkg/compactor/bucket_compactor.go — Add parallel CompactWithDeletionMarkers method to Mimir metaSyncer and wrapper to BucketCompactor.
- mimir/pkg/storage/tsdb/block/markers.go — Reference Mimir's DeletionMark struct definition.
- mimir/pkg/compactor/compactor.go — Update compactUser to fetch deletion marks and call the new method.
- mimir/pkg/compactor/syncer_metrics.go — Add optional metric for tracking deletion-mark-aware compaction events.
